description: List sales orders — orders CUSTOMERS placed with this business (customer orders by default; in any language a customer's orders are sales orders, not purchase orders) for reconciliation / status reporting — e.g. to verify imported/pushed orders landed. OPEN ORDERS: in everyday speech "open" or "outstanding" sales orders means the ones not fulfilled yet — pass state=open (created through packed, ready to ship, awaiting pickup, backordered, partly shipped). state=closed is the finished ones (shipped, completed, canceled). There is no status named open. Filters (all optional, AND-combined): type (sales [default], sro); state (open, closed); status (one exact lifecycle status, e.g. created, approved, picking, shipped, completed, canceled; with state it must belong to that state — unknown values are rejected); partnerSearch (customer name); numberSearch (case-insensitive substring of the SO number OR of the linked channel order number — a Shopify order number like 154938 or an Amazon order id finds the SO it became, so try it before asking what a bare number refers to); sku (only SOs with a line for that exact SKU); createdFrom/createdTo (ISO 8601 bounds on the created date — historical imports are dated from their order date). Newest first. Paged: returns Total (pre-paging — the answer to "how many") plus the page; default 100, max 500. Each row is an order-level summary (customer, store, total, line count, lifecycle dates) — not line detail. A client-pinned token sees only its own client's SOs; an operator token sees the whole tenant's.

createdFrom.description: Only SOs created on/after this ISO 8601 instant, or from the start of this local day for a bare YYYY-MM-DD.

createdTo.description: Only SOs created on/before this ISO 8601 instant, or through the end of this local day for a bare YYYY-MM-DD.

numberSearch.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the SO number or on the linked channel order number (Shopify order number, Amazon order id).

partnerSearch.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the customer name.

sku.description: Return only SOs containing a line for this exact SKU (case-insensitive).

state.description: Grouped lifecycle filter. open = not fulfilled yet (created, approved, issued, waitingApproval, waitingbackorder, backorder, pending, picking, picked, packing, packed, readyForShipping, waitingPersonalPickup, shipping) — what "open sales orders" means in everyday speech. closed = finished (shipped, completed, canceled). Omit for both.

status.description: Exact lifecycle status, one value (e.g. approved, shipped, completed). For "open orders" use state=open instead. Omit for all statuses.

name: get_sales_orders
title: List Sales Orders
